scope: Compare React Native 0.87.1 default root generated ViewProps with RNMapbox 10.3.7 ComponentProps<MapView> and MapLibre React Native 11.5.0 MapProps. basis.rootResolution: react-native package.json exports["."].types and types resolve types_generated/index.d.ts under default Bundler conditions. The react-native-legacy-deep-imports condition selects handwritten types but is not active in this audit.

comparison.primaryArtifactComparison: Exact same key set as artifacts/host-props/native-keys.json at inspection. The earlier 111 count is superseded by the current 112-key artifact; no extra audit key.
comparison.sourceOnlyVsRuntime: Both wrapper map props inherit the generated host type. Their render implementations forward props to native map components but keep outer onLayout private. one-map-react can forward host props on its owned outer RN View. Type inheritance alone does not prove native event delivery or Android-only drawable behavior on iOS.

signatureFindings.explanation: Generated ViewProps composition lets ViewPropsAndroid override PointerEventProps.onClick. onClickCapture remains ((event: PointerEvent) => void) | undefined. Both selected wrapper props resolve this same distinction.

signatureFindings.explanation: KeyDownEvent and KeyUpEvent wrap KeyEvent in NativeSyntheticEvent, retaining propagation methods, target ownership and event metadata.

signatureFindings.signature: target: number | HostInstance | undefined; currentTarget: number | HostInstance; HostInstance = ReactNativeElement
signatureFindings.explanation: The selected generated event envelope is not limited to numeric React tags. Reuse the host type; avoid a lossy numeric-only copy or accidental browser Event typing.

Generated callbacks generally use undefined without the handwritten null branch, and some return unknown instead of void. Existing IDs must remain while their selected-root signatures and provenance are reconciled; do not retain handwritten signatures as the current default contract.
Generated declaration comments mention nativeID, while the actual type remains number. This audit preserves the type and leaves runtime identifier interpretation for the host tests.
